_comment: The one place repo, board and people are named. Filled by .claude/scripts/setup-github.py; edit by hand for people, areas and wait_guard. Scripts and hooks read this, nothing is hard-coded. The template ships it empty: setup-github.py writes the repo, owner, board and people of the repo it runs in.

purge._comment: Where /purge (.claude/skills/purge, the generic shared skill) finds this repository's test bookkeeping: each value a command run at a worktree root, or an instruction where there is no command.
purge.test_check: python3 -m tools.test_register --check (and --replay <test> for a row added or folded into)
purge.test_new: python3 -m tools.test_register --new <module or group> --says "<what it pins>" (its row in tools/test_register/_rows.py carries the break)
purge.time_budget: no per-file limit in the register; the suite within the time the deploy gate allows
